name: r_zl_freeplay_city042_night_travel_mcw
description: One distinct disposable ordinary nighttime city-travel account, installed from the native-saved zero-credit night setup copy. Only player-selected native actions in this account may supply ordinary-play evidence.

steps.label: settle_native_night_copy
steps.expected_visible_fact: the saved nighttime city copy loads before any ordinary player choice

steps.label: operate_ordinary_night_flashlight_travel
steps.objective: Make ordinary player-visible nighttime city travel decisions. Use the currently advertised native inventory/item controls if a flashlight is needed; choose route, pauses, disengagement, or interaction from the actual World surface. Preserve broad visible context and any natural survival, lighting, base, or rider consequence, but do not use a focused-light fixture or pre-script decisions.
proof_targets: ordinary player-selected nighttime travel and elapsed time
current native flashlight/inventory action if chosen
visible lighting and local survival consequences
any naturally player-legible lit-base or late-rider consequence
native action receipts and source/executable/process/run binding
invariants: the saved setup copy is zero-credit footing only
no debug, observer, attention, knowledge, contact, actor, or route injection
no diagnostic-selected light fixture or actor
only player-visible native facts support the account conclusion

steps.label: save_and_exit_ordinary_night_account
steps.objective: At the honest ordinary-play boundary, use native Save and Quit, native Main-menu Quit, and their native confirmations.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the ordinary account saves, returns to the main menu, and its owned process exits

evidence_contract.claim: one separate source-bound ordinary nighttime account may supply a partial assessment of player-visible flashlight travel and any naturally occurring lit-base or late-rider consequence
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: native-saved setup footing only / zero inherited setup credit
evidence_contract.writeback_note: the copied nighttime footing earns no ordinary evidence; only player-selected actions in this fresh account do
